file_categories.label: Municipal profile and official statistics
file_categories.guidance: Ask for the legal identity, statistical codes, source year and a citation.

file_categories.label: Adopted energy or climate plan
file_categories.guidance: Ask for the adopted plan and resolution, baseline year and the page that identifies each target.

file_categories.label: Local development strategy
file_categories.guidance: Ask for the adopted local development strategy, including projects, consultation and implementation priorities.

file_categories.label: Governance and team records
file_categories.guidance: Ask for the team appointment, a signed mandate and the roles of each participating department.

file_categories.label: Consultation and partnership records
file_categories.guidance: Ask for the date, participating groups and findings from the relevant consultation.

file_categories.label: Annex D · Energy impact
file_categories.guidance: Ask for the calculation workbook, annual savings and production in GWh, assumptions and source year.

file_categories.label: Annex E · Investment cost
file_categories.guidance: Ask for the itemised cost estimate, currency, price year, investment total and calculation basis.

file_categories.label: Political support and council decisions
file_categories.guidance: Ask for the signed letter or dated resolution naming the authorised representative.

file_categories.label: Project decisions and delivery plan
file_categories.guidance: Ask for the team's approved decision, responsible person and dated supporting note.

file_categories.label: Other documents
file_categories.guidance: Check what this document supports before requesting additional evidence.

chapters.title: 1. Identification of the applicant
chapters.description: General information about the applicant: name, type, codes, population and contacts. Not scored, checked for eligibility.

required_fields.label: Name of the municipality
required_fields.description: Official name of the municipality or local authority applying.

required_fields.label: Type of applicant
required_fields.description: Whether the applicant is a single municipality, a grouping, or a local public entity aggregating municipalities.
choices: Grouping of municipalities or local authorities

required_fields.label: Country
required_fields.description: Country of the applicant.

required_fields.label: NUTS 3 code
required_fields.description: Code of the NUTS 3 region the municipality belongs to.

required_fields.label: LAU code
required_fields.description: Local administrative unit code of the municipality.

required_fields.label: Total population
required_fields.description: Total number of residents, as an absolute number.
required_fields.evidence_need: Official statistics or a city report, with the year

required_fields.label: Contact person
required_fields.description: Name, role and contact details of the person responsible for the application.

required_fields.label: Mayor or political representative
required_fields.description: Who signs the letter of support (Annex B).

chapters.title: 2.1 Title of the proposed investment concept
chapters.description: A short title for the investment concept.

required_fields.label: Title of the investment concept
required_fields.description: Title of the proposed investment concept.

chapters.title: 2.2 Allocation of grant amount
chapters.description: How the EUR 60,000 grant will be split. For monitoring only, not scored.

required_fields.label: Allocation of the grant
required_fields.description: How the grant is split between in-house staff, external experts or sub-contractors, and other positions. More than one may apply.

chapters.title: 2.3 Activities funded by grant amount
chapters.description: The missing components for developing the investment concept and the activities the grant will pay for. For monitoring only, not scored.

required_fields.label: Long-term goal the concept serves
required_fields.description: The city's energy and climate goal and target year that the investment concept works towards.

required_fields.label: Missing components
required_fields.description: What is missing today to develop the investment concept and how the grant fills the gap.

required_fields.label: Activities to be funded
required_fields.description: The studies and analyses the grant will fund, for example technical, legal, financial, social or market studies.

chapters.title: 2.4 Governance for investment concept development
chapters.description: Internal organisation for developing the concept: structure, roles, how decisions are taken, and whether outside experts are needed. Scored as criterion B1.

required_fields.label: Who supervises and takes final decisions
required_fields.description: The person with final decision-making power for the project.

required_fields.label: Who manages the project team
required_fields.description: The person in charge of the investment concept development day to day.

required_fields.label: Project team and departments
required_fields.description: Departments and competences in the project team.
required_fields.evidence_need: Formal appointment of the project team

required_fields.label: Roles and tasks of each actor
required_fields.description: Specific tasks and responsibilities of the people and bodies involved.

required_fields.label: How decisions are taken
required_fields.description: The decision-making process: who proposes, who decides, how the team schedules and tracks work.

required_fields.label: Municipal companies involved
required_fields.description: Municipal companies taking part and who represents them.
required_fields.evidence_need: City ownership records or company documents

required_fields.label: Need for external experts
required_fields.description: Whether internal capacity is enough and in which fields outside experts will be engaged.

chapters.title: 2.5 Engagement of stakeholders
chapters.description: The most relevant external stakeholders, their needs, and the activities and communication tools to engage them, with timing and objectives. Scored as criterion B2.

required_fields.label: Stakeholder groups
required_fields.description: The external stakeholder groups most relevant to the investment project.
required_fields.evidence_need: Consultation records or a strategy document

required_fields.label: Needs and expectations
required_fields.description: What each group needs and expects from the project.

required_fields.label: Engagement activities
required_fields.description: Activities planned to involve the stakeholders while the concept is developed.

required_fields.label: Timing and objective of each activity
required_fields.description: When each activity happens and what it is meant to achieve.

required_fields.label: Communication channels
required_fields.description: Channels used to reach the different groups.

chapters.title: 3.1 Investment sector(s) targeted
chapters.description: The sectors targeted by the investment project, and the main one.

required_fields.label: Main sector
required_fields.description: The main sector targeted by the investment project.

required_fields.label: Other sectors targeted
required_fields.description: All other sectors the project covers.

chapters.title: 3.2 Intended measures
chapters.description: The technology measures to be financed. Measures excluded by the European Investment Bank energy lending policy are not eligible.

required_fields.label: Technology measures
required_fields.description: The intended technology measures to be financed.
required_fields.evidence_need: Climate or energy plan measures list

required_fields.label: Phases and years
required_fields.description: The stages of implementation and their years.

required_fields.label: Link to the adopted plan
required_fields.description: Which adopted plan the measures come from and how they relate to it.
required_fields.evidence_need: SEAP, SECAP or plan of similar ambition

required_fields.label: Eligibility under the EIB energy lending policy
required_fields.description: Confirmation that none of the measures is excluded.

chapters.title: 3.3 Expected size of investment
chapters.description: Approximate total investment in sustainable energy, in euro, with the calculation in Annex E. Scored as criterion A1.

required_fields.label: Total investment size
required_fields.description: Approximate total investment in sustainable energy for the project. This is not the EUR 60,000 grant.

required_fields.label: Investment by sector
required_fields.description: Investment per sector as in Annex E.

required_fields.label: Basis of the estimate
required_fields.description: Parameters and unit costs used for the estimate.
required_fields.evidence_need: Cost estimates, plans or comparable projects

chapters.title: 3.4 Expected impacts
chapters.description: Expected energy savings and renewable energy production in GWh per year, with the calculation in Annex D. Savings must be higher than renewable production. Scored as criterion A2.

required_fields.label: Expected energy savings
required_fields.description: Approximate energy savings generated by the project.

required_fields.label: Expected renewable energy production
required_fields.description: Approximate renewable energy production generated by the project.

required_fields.label: Savings higher than renewable production
required_fields.description: Eligibility rule: renewable production may not be more than 50% of the total impact.

required_fields.label: Baseline energy use
required_fields.description: The city's energy consumption used as the baseline, with its year.

required_fields.label: Avoided CO2 emissions
required_fields.description: Expected CO2 reduction, if available.

required_fields.label: Other expected impacts
required_fields.description: Further impacts such as jobs created, if available.

chapters.title: 3.5 Potential for replication and/or up-scaling
chapters.description: How the project could be replicated elsewhere or scaled up in its region. Part of criterion B3.

required_fields.label: How the project can be replicated or scaled
required_fields.description: What makes the project replicable or scalable.

required_fields.label: Networks and partners for sharing
required_fields.description: Networks, associations and partners through which the experience will be shared.
required_fields.evidence_need: Memberships and partnerships of the city

chapters.title: Annex A.2 Summary of the climate and energy plan
chapters.description: Summary, in English, of the SEAP, SECAP or plan of similar ambition submitted as Annex A.1.

required_fields.label: Plan name and adoption
required_fields.description: Name of the plan, the adopting council resolution and its date.

required_fields.label: Emission reduction target
required_fields.description: The plan's CO2 reduction target and target year.

required_fields.label: Baseline emissions
required_fields.description: Baseline year and total emissions in the plan.

required_fields.label: Key measures of the plan
required_fields.description: The main measures in the plan.

rules.label: Renewable production must not exceed half of total energy impact
